core_question: How do I fix leather shoes that have dried out and started to crack? (secondary: How do I fix a toilet tank that keeps running long after being flushed?)
answer_summary: Clean the leather, then massage in a leather conditioner or oil such as neatsfoot oil to replenish lost moisture and restore flexibility, buffing off the excess once absorbed.; after the topic shift: Turn off the water, drain the tank, and swap the old, warped rubber flapper for a new one sized to fit the flush valve seat so the tank seals properly.
persona: tired and blunt; writing terse one-liners
